header: Generated from packages/scenario-kit. Do not edit.

constructs.name: scenario
constructs.summary: A complete scenario document. Resources default to every resource a station stores, in the order stations first store them.

params.name: id
params.summary: Scenario id: a letter, then letters, digits, _ or -.

params.name: title
params.summary: Title shown to players.

params.name: description
params.summary: What the scenario shows.

params.name: docs
params.summary: Documentation page explaining the scenario, such as book/flows#case-study-dead-stock.

params.name: duration
params.summary: Length of a run.

params.name: seed
params.summary: Base seed for random processes.

params.name: information
params.summary: How much of other stations policies can see.

params.name: sample_interval
params.summary: How often stock is sampled for charts.

params.name: resources
params.summary: Resources as ids, resource constructs, or parameters keyed by id.

params.name: stations
params.summary: Stations, in scenario order.

params.name: arcs
params.summary: Arcs joining stations.

params.name: vehicles
params.summary: Vehicles and their routes.

params.name: events
params.summary: Events such as storms.

params.name: parts
params.summary: Tables with stations, arcs, vehicles or events lists, such as the result of line, appended in order.

constructs.name: resource
constructs.summary: A resource and its priority.

params.name: id
params.summary: Resource id, such as Metals.

params.name: priority
params.summary: Higher numbers matter more to priority allocation.

constructs.name: station
constructs.summary: A place that stores resources, with what produces, consumes, converts and supplies them.

params.name: id
params.summary: Station id.

params.name: resources
params.summary: Resources stored: ids with default storage, store constructs, or store parameters keyed by resource id.

params.name: producers
params.summary: What adds stock.

params.name: consumers
params.summary: What takes stock as demand.

params.name: converters
params.summary: What turns some resources into others.

params.name: suppliers
params.summary: Where the station orders resources from.

params.name: review
params.summary: When the station reviews its orders.

params.name: position
params.summary: Where to draw the station on the map.

constructs.name: store
constructs.summary: How a station stores one resource.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource id.

params.name: capacity
params.summary: Most the station can hold.

params.name: initial
params.summary: Stock at the start of a run.

params.name: expires
params.summary: Whether stock is removed at each review.

params.name: holding_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit held per sol.

constructs.name: producer
constructs.summary: Adds a resource to its station, by exactly one of rate, poisson, per_period or trace.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource id.

params.name: rate
params.summary: Amount produced per sol, spread evenly over each minute.

params.name: variability
params.summary: How the rate varies over time. Fixed when omitted.

params.name: poisson
params.summary: Arrivals at random times instead of a rate.

params.name: per_period
params.summary: An amount drawn at the start of each period instead of a rate.

params.name: trace
params.summary: Recorded amounts per period instead of a rate.

params.name: profile
params.summary: Multipliers over the run, for ramps and seasons.

params.name: stall_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit of production that does not fit.

constructs.name: consumer
constructs.summary: Takes a resource from its station as demand, by exactly one of rate, poisson, per_period or trace.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource id.

params.name: rate
params.summary: Amount demanded per sol, spread evenly over each minute.

params.name: variability
params.summary: How the rate varies over time. Fixed when omitted.

params.name: poisson
params.summary: Arrivals at random times instead of a rate.

params.name: per_period
params.summary: An amount drawn at the start of each period instead of a rate.

params.name: trace
params.summary: Recorded amounts per period instead of a rate.

params.name: profile
params.summary: Multipliers over the run, for ramps and seasons.

params.name: unmet
params.summary: Whether demand that cannot be met is lost or waits for stock.

params.name: lost_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit of lost demand.

params.name: backorder_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit backordered per sol.

constructs.name: uniform
constructs.summary: Varies a rate uniformly within a range, drawing a new rate each period.

params.name: range
params.summary: Largest change from the base rate, in percent.

params.name: period
params.summary: How long each drawn rate lasts.

constructs.name: bursts
constructs.summary: Switches a rate on and off at random.

params.name: on_ppm
params.summary: Chance per minute of switching on, in parts per million.

params.name: off_ppm
params.summary: Chance per minute of switching off, in parts per million.

params.name: starts_on
params.summary: Whether the flow starts on.

constructs.name: poisson
constructs.summary: Arrivals at random times at an average rate, each of a fixed or random size.

params.name: per_sol
params.summary: Average arrivals per sol.

params.name: size
params.summary: Size of each arrival.

constructs.name: per_period
constructs.summary: An amount drawn at the start of each period and spread evenly over it.

params.name: period
params.summary: Length of each period.

params.name: amount
params.summary: Amount for each period.

constructs.name: trace
constructs.summary: Recorded amounts, one per period, repeated from the start when they run out.

params.name: period
params.summary: Length of each period.

params.name: amounts
params.summary: Amount for each period.

constructs.name: converter
constructs.summary: Turns input resources into output resources at its station, in batches.

params.name: inputs
params.summary: Amount of each resource each batch takes.

params.name: outputs
params.summary: Amount of each resource each batch makes.

params.name: rate
params.summary: Batches per sol.

params.name: variability
params.summary: How the rate varies over time. Fixed when omitted.

constructs.name: supplier
constructs.summary: Where a station orders one resource from, and how long orders take to arrive.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource id.

params.name: from
params.summary: external, or the id of the station that ships from its own stock.

params.name: lead_time
params.summary: Time from order to arrival.

params.name: min_order
params.summary: Smallest order.

params.name: max_order
params.summary: Largest order.

params.name: order_cost
params.summary: Fixed cost per order.

params.name: unit_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit ordered.

constructs.name: review
constructs.summary: A schedule of reviews, when the policy decides what the station orders.

params.name: period
params.summary: Time between reviews.

params.name: offset
params.summary: Time of the first review.

constructs.name: arc
constructs.summary: Joins two stations, in both directions.

params.name: from
params.summary: Station id at one end.

params.name: to
params.summary: Station id at the other end.

params.name: distance
params.summary: Length of the arc.

constructs.name: line
constructs.summary: Stations joined in order by arcs. Pass the result to scenario's parts.

params.name: stations
params.summary: Stations from one end of the line to the other.

params.name: distances
params.summary: Distance between neighbours, or one per gap.

constructs.name: shuttle
constructs.summary: A route back and forth along its stops, reversing at each end.

params.name: stops
params.summary: Stations in order; neighbours must be joined by arcs.

params.name: start
params.summary: Stop the vehicle starts at.

params.name: direction
params.summary: Direction the vehicle starts in.

constructs.name: loop
constructs.summary: A route around its stops and back to the first, repeatedly.

params.name: stops
params.summary: Stations in order; the last joins back to the first.

params.name: start
params.summary: Stop the vehicle starts at.

constructs.name: timetable
constructs.summary: Trips out along its stops and back, leaving the first stop at listed times.

params.name: stops
params.summary: Stations in order from the first stop.

params.name: departures
params.summary: Departure times from the first stop.

constructs.name: vehicle
constructs.summary: A vehicle on a fixed route.

params.name: id
params.summary: Vehicle id.

params.name: route
params.summary: The route it follows.

params.name: speed
params.summary: Distance per second.

params.name: dwell
params.summary: Time at every stop.

params.name: dwell_per_unit
params.summary: Extra time per unit loaded or unloaded.

params.name: capacity
params.summary: Units it can carry across all resources, or units by resource id.

params.name: cost_per_distance
params.summary: Cost per unit of distance travelled.

constructs.name: effect
constructs.summary: How an event changes production or demand while it is active.

params.name: type
params.summary: supply scales production; demand scales consumption.

params.name: stations
params.summary: Stations affected.

params.name: resources
params.summary: Resources affected.

params.name: multiplier
params.summary: Rate multiplier: 0 stops the flow, 2.5 multiplies it by two and a half.

params.name: start_offset
params.summary: When the effect starts after the event starts.

params.name: duration
params.summary: How long the effect lasts.

constructs.name: event
constructs.summary: Something that changes rates for a while, at a fixed time or at random.

params.name: id
params.summary: Event id.

params.name: label
params.summary: Name shown to players.

params.name: start
params.summary: Start time of a fixed event.

params.name: duration
params.summary: How long the event lasts.

params.name: chance_ppm
params.summary: Chance at each check of a random event starting, in parts per million.

params.name: check_every
params.summary: Time between checks of a random event.

params.name: effects
params.summary: What the event changes.

constructs.name: discrete
constructs.summary: Weighted values, such as discrete { { 2, 1 }, { 3, 2 } }, drawn with chance proportional to weight. Values are converted by the parameter they are given to.

params.name: pairs
params.summary: Value and whole-number weight pairs.

constructs.name: profile
constructs.summary: Multipliers at times in the run, such as profile { { sols(0), 1 }, { sols(10), 2 } }, interpolated linearly between points.

params.name: points
params.summary: Time and multiplier pairs.

constructs.name: units
constructs.summary: Milli-units in a quantity of units, for changing a construct's result. Rejects values finer than 0.001 units.

params.name: value
params.summary: Quantity in units, such as 2.5.

constructs.name: minutes
constructs.summary: Milliseconds in a number of minutes, where one minute is 60000 ms. Rejects values that are not a whole number of milliseconds.

params.name: value
params.summary: Number of minutes, such as 1.5.

constructs.name: hours
constructs.summary: Milliseconds in a number of hours, where one hour is 60 minutes. Rejects values that are not a whole number of milliseconds.

params.name: value
params.summary: Number of hours, such as 1.5.

constructs.name: sols
constructs.summary: Milliseconds in a number of sols, where one sol is 24 hours. Rejects values that are not a whole number of milliseconds.

params.name: value
params.summary: Number of sols, such as 1.5.

constructs.name: days
constructs.summary: Milliseconds in a number of days, where one day is 24 hours, the same as a sol. Rejects values that are not a whole number of milliseconds.

params.name: value
params.summary: Number of days, such as 1.5.

constructs.name: weeks
constructs.summary: Milliseconds in a number of weeks, where one week is 7 days. Rejects values that are not a whole number of milliseconds.

params.name: value
params.summary: Number of weeks, such as 1.5.

constructs.name: mars.line
constructs.summary: A rail line: stations in order joined by track, and trains shuttling along all of it. Resource priorities default to mars.PRIORITIES.

params.name: id
params.summary: Scenario id.

params.name: title
params.summary: Title shown to players.

params.name: description
params.summary: What the scenario shows.

params.name: docs
params.summary: Documentation page explaining the scenario.

params.name: duration
params.summary: Length of a run.

params.name: seed
params.summary: Base seed for random processes.

params.name: information
params.summary: How much of other stations policies can see.

params.name: resources
params.summary: Resource ids in scenario order.
params.default: in the order stations store them

params.name: stations
params.summary: Stations from one end of the line to the other.

params.name: distances
params.summary: Track length between neighbours, or one per gap.

params.name: trains
params.summary: Trains built with mars.train.

params.name: events
params.summary: Disasters, such as mars.dust_storm.

constructs.name: mars.small_station
constructs.summary: A small station: 30 units of storage for each resource it stores.

params.name: id
params.summary: Station id.

params.name: resources
params.summary: Resources the station stores, in order, before any its buildings and stock add.

params.name: stock
params.summary: Stock at the start of a run, by resource id.

params.name: capacity
params.summary: Storage by resource id, instead of 30 units.

params.name: buildings
params.summary: Buildings next to the station, such as mars.extractor.

constructs.name: mars.large_station
constructs.summary: A large station: 60 units of storage for each resource it stores.

params.name: id
params.summary: Station id.

params.name: resources
params.summary: Resources the station stores, in order, before any its buildings and stock add.

params.name: stock
params.summary: Stock at the start of a run, by resource id.

params.name: capacity
params.summary: Storage by resource id, instead of 60 units.

params.name: buildings
params.summary: Buildings next to the station, such as mars.extractor.

constructs.name: mars.train
constructs.summary: A train shuttling along the whole line.

params.name: id
params.summary: Train id.

params.name: start
params.summary: Station the train starts at.

params.name: direction
params.summary: Direction it starts in along the line.

params.name: speed
params.summary: Distance per second.

params.name: capacity
params.summary: Units it carries across all resources.

params.name: dwell
params.summary: Time at every station.

params.name: dwell_per_unit
params.summary: Extra time per unit loaded or unloaded.

constructs.name: mars.extractor
constructs.summary: Extracts a resource from a deposit, such as metals.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource extracted.

params.name: rate
params.summary: Output per sol.

params.name: variability
params.summary: A percentage for a uniform range over two hours, or a uniform or bursts construct. Fixed when omitted.

constructs.name: mars.farm
constructs.summary: Grows food.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource grown.

params.name: rate
params.summary: Output per sol.

params.name: variability
params.summary: A percentage for a uniform range over two hours, or a uniform or bursts construct. Fixed when omitted.

constructs.name: mars.producer
constructs.summary: Any other building that adds a resource.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource produced.

params.name: rate
params.summary: Output per sol.

params.name: variability
params.summary: A percentage for a uniform range over two hours, or a uniform or bursts construct. Fixed when omitted.

constructs.name: mars.consumer
constructs.summary: Any other building that uses a resource, such as for maintenance.

params.name: resource
params.summary: Resource used.

params.name: rate
params.summary: Use per sol.

params.name: variability
params.summary: A percentage for a uniform range over two hours, or a uniform or bursts construct. Fixed when omitted.

constructs.name: mars.dome
constructs.summary: A dome whose colonists use resources.

params.name: consumes
params.summary: Use per sol by resource id, or a list such as { { "Food", 45, variability = 20 } } to keep an order.

params.name: variability
params.summary: A percentage for a uniform range over two hours, or a uniform or bursts construct. Fixed when omitted.

constructs.name: mars.factory
constructs.summary: Turns input resources into output resources in batches.

params.name: inputs
params.summary: Resources each batch uses.

params.name: outputs
params.summary: Resources each batch makes.

params.name: rate
params.summary: Batches per sol.

params.name: variability
params.summary: A percentage for a uniform range over two hours, or a uniform or bursts construct. Fixed when omitted.

constructs.name: mars.dust_storm
constructs.summary: A dust storm that stops production while it lasts, optionally followed by a surge in demand for repairs.

params.name: id
params.summary: Event id.

params.name: start
params.summary: When the storm starts, for a storm at a fixed time.

params.name: duration
params.summary: How long the storm lasts.

params.name: chance_ppm
params.summary: Chance at each check of a random storm starting, in parts per million.

params.name: check_every
params.summary: Time between checks of a random storm.

params.name: stations
params.summary: Stations the storm covers.

params.name: surge
params.summary: Extra demand after the storm starts: a multiplier (default 2) for a resource at a station, starting after a delay and lasting a duration.

constructs.name: classic.newsvendor
constructs.summary: One stand whose unsold stock expires at each daily review, facing random demand each period with lost sales.

params.name: demand
params.summary: Demand in each period.

params.name: unit_cost
params.summary: Cost of each unit ordered.

params.name: lost_cost
params.summary: Cost of each unit of demand that finds no stock.

params.name: period
params.summary: Length of a selling period, with a review at its start.

params.name: periods
params.summary: Number of periods in a run.

params.name: seed
params.summary: Base seed for random demand.

constructs.name: classic.reorder
constructs.summary: One store replenished from an outside supplier after a lead time, facing steady or random demand, with holding, ordering and shortage costs.

params.name: demand
params.summary: Average demand per day.

params.name: random
params.summary: Poisson arrivals of one unit each instead of a steady rate.

params.name: lead_time
params.summary: Time from order to delivery.

params.name: review_period
params.summary: Time between reviews.

params.name: holding_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit held per day.

params.name: order_cost
params.summary: Fixed cost per order.

params.name: unit_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit ordered.

params.name: shortage
params.summary: Whether unmet demand is lost or backordered.

params.name: shortage_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit lost, or per unit backordered per day.

params.name: initial
params.summary: Stock at the start of a run.

params.name: duration
params.summary: Length of a run.

params.name: seed
params.summary: Base seed for random demand.

constructs.name: classic.safety_stock
constructs.summary: One store reviewed on a schedule, facing Poisson demand with backorders and a supplier whose lead time may vary, with a target cycle service level for its reference policy.

params.name: demand
params.summary: Average demand per day, arriving one unit at a time.

params.name: lead_time
params.summary: Time from order to delivery, fixed or drawn for each order. The longest and shortest must differ by less than the review period.

params.name: review_period
params.summary: Time between reviews.

params.name: target_service
params.summary: Chance that a review cycle ends with no customers waiting, which the reference policy's order-up-to level aims for.

params.name: holding_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit held per day.

params.name: backorder_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit backordered per day.

params.name: initial
params.summary: Stock at the start of a run.

params.name: duration
params.summary: Length of a run.

params.name: seed
params.summary: Base seed for random demand.

constructs.name: classic.forecasting
constructs.summary: One store reviewed daily whose demand grows by a trend and may rise and fall with a season, with or without Poisson noise, and a reference policy that forecasts by exponential smoothing.

params.name: level
params.summary: Demand on the first day.

params.name: trend
params.summary: How much demand grows each day.

params.name: season_length
params.summary: Days in a season, with demand raised in its first half and lowered in its second; 0 for none.

params.name: season_amplitude
params.summary: Fraction by which a season raises and lowers demand.

params.name: noise
params.summary: Poisson arrivals around each day's demand instead of exactly that amount.

params.name: alpha
params.summary: Weight the reference policy's forecast gives the latest day.

params.name: lead_time
params.summary: Time from order to delivery, in whole days.

params.name: safety
params.summary: Stock the reference policy holds above its forecast.

params.name: holding_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit held per day.

params.name: backorder_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit backordered per day.

params.name: duration
params.summary: Length of a run.

params.name: seed
params.summary: Base seed for random demand.

constructs.name: classic.serial_chain
constructs.summary: Stages in series, each ordering from the one before it with a shipping lead time, and customer demand with backorders at the last stage, in the style of the beer game.

params.name: stages
params.summary: Number of stages, from 2 to 10.

params.name: lead_time
params.summary: Shipping time into each stage.

params.name: review_period
params.summary: Time between each stage's reviews, and the demand period.

params.name: demand
params.summary: Customer demand each period.

params.name: holding_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit held per day at every stage.

params.name: backorder_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit of customer demand backordered per day.

params.name: initial
params.summary: Stock at every stage at the start.

params.name: duration
params.summary: Length of a run.

params.name: seed
params.summary: Base seed for random demand.

constructs.name: classic.fixed_route_delivery
constructs.summary: A depot supplied from outside and customers that trucks visit on a fixed loop, with lost sales when a customer runs dry.

params.name: customers
params.summary: Number of customers, from 1 to 20.

params.name: demand
params.summary: Demand per day at each customer.

params.name: customer_capacity
params.summary: Storage at each customer.

params.name: customer_initial
params.summary: Stock at each customer at the start.

params.name: distance
params.summary: Length of each leg of the loop.

params.name: vehicles
params.summary: Number of trucks, from 1 to 10.

params.name: vehicle_capacity
params.summary: What each truck carries.

params.name: speed
params.summary: Truck speed in distance per second.

params.name: lead_time
params.summary: Time from a depot order to delivery.

params.name: review_period
params.summary: Time between depot reviews.

params.name: depot_initial
params.summary: Stock at the depot at the start.

params.name: lost_cost
params.summary: Cost per unit of customer demand lost.

params.name: cost_per_distance
params.summary: Transport cost per unit of distance.

params.name: duration
params.summary: Length of a run.

params.name: seed
params.summary: Base seed for random demand.
